name: Input
description: A single-line text field with a visible label and optional help text.
extends: InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement> without the native size attribute, with the ref forwarded to the <input>
whenToUse: Single-line text entry: names, emails, search terms.
Any field that needs a visible label and, optionally, a short hint.
whenNotToUse: Choosing from a fixed list: use a select or a radio group.
Showing a validation error: Input has no error state yet.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label, rendered as a <label> linked to the input.

props.name: hint
props.description: Help text under the input, linked with aria-describedby.

props.name: variant
props.description: Bordered field or a filled field without border.

props.name: size
props.description: Height, padding and text size, from RECIPES.input.sizes. Replaces the native size attribute.

props.name: id
props.description: Input id. When omitted, one is generated with useId().

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Native placeholder. An example value, never a replacement for the label.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the <input>, merged after the recipe with cn().

states.name: default
states.description: outline: color.surface with a color.border hairline. filled: color.surface tinted with color.text, no visible border.

states.name: hover
states.description: Only while enabled. outline: the border moves towards color.text. filled: the tint gets stronger. data-force="hover" pins this state for docs and visual tests.

states.name: focus
states.description: focus-visible: the border turns color.primary and a 4px color.primary ring at 25% appears.

states.name: disabled
states.description: 50% opacity, not-allowed cursor, hover styles switched off.

tokens.usage: outline background, and the base of the filled tint.
Typed text and label; filled tint and outline hover border are mixed from it.
Label text, and the typed text at size md (text-sm, same value).

accessibility.role: textbox for text-like types, from the native <input> element.
keyboard: Tab moves focus to it; typing and editing are native.
accessibility.focus: Keep the focus-visible style (color.primary border and ring). Never remove it without a visible replacement.
accessibility.contrast: Typed text, label and hint at least 4.5:1 (WCAG 2.2 AA, 1.4.3). The field boundary at least 3:1 against its surroundings (1.4.11).
accessibility.labels: label is required and rendered as a visible <label for>. Do not use the placeholder as the label. The hint is announced through aria-describedby.

composition: Renders its own label and hint: do not wrap it in another <label>.
To submit, place it in a <form> with a Button of type submit; Input does not render one.

example.code:
<Input
  type="email"
  label="Email"
  hint="We'll only use it to reply."
  placeholder="you@company.com"
/>
